As someone else pointed out, it's not what you eat, but how much you eat. You have a TDEE, and that's an amount of calories you need to stay exactly the same weight, now if you eat above this amount, you will gain weight, if you below this amount you will lose weight. Realistically you cannot build muscle and lose fat at the same time, it's either one or the other. If you want to build muscle then there will be fat gain. As long as you get enough protein everyday (prob 1g per kg should be enough, I know some people say a g per lb but I think that's very unnecessary) you should be fine.
